segments.name: consumer product
segments.description: Produces and distributes bamboo charcoal-based purification, deodorization, household cleaning and barbecue charcoal products for China's domestic consumer market.
segments.evidence: In our consumer product segment, we face competition from a number of companies that have similar product portfolios.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for bamboo charcoal consumer products sold under the Charcoal Doctor brand and purchased barbecue charcoals sold through its distribution channel.
revenueModel.evidence: Purification and deodorization products and household cleaning products are sold under the brand name "Charcoal Doctor."

changes.text: During 2023 the company merged its biodegradable packaging business segment into its consumer products segment.
changes.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2023 we merged its biodegradable packaging business segment into its consumer products segment.
